alt: The payment provider taken down: the worker that calls it fails, its queue retries into the dead-letter queue, and handwritten notes ask what the drawing leaves open.
A proxy, load balancer, gateway, module, port, adapter, external system, scheduler and worker, each with its own drawing and its name underneath.
The pointer resting on the payment worker shows its note beside it without selecting or opening anything.
The Arrange preview with one shape held in place: the rest of the diagram is laid out around it and the bar counts connector crossings before and after.
Presenting a diagram that has no flows: the walk has reached the checkout connector, with the steps so far lit and the rest stepped back.
